source.description: Follow-up cross-period orientation: four development-selected cases evaluated in validation, five validation-informed cases evaluated in 2026, plus A03 context. Not an input to original development selection.

metricDefinitions.label: Failure to generalize
metricDefinitions.definition: At primary 20 bps, all four Track A cases had negative 2024–2025 compounded net returns and all five Track B cases had negative January–September 2026 compounded net returns. B06 arithmetic daily raw Sharpe is slightly positive despite compounded loss. A03 had strong 2026 performance after losing in validation. This is consistent with overfitting/weak transfer, not proof of a single cause; track baskets/settings/cadence differ and Track B adds long/cash. 252 Sharpe is 365 Sharpe times sqrt(252/365).

evidenceFlow.title: Frozen-strategy follow-up orientation
evidenceFlow.detail: Read the existing 20 bps strategy_summary.csv; select Track A validation four, Track B2026 five and A03 context in 2026 context. No new backtest, strategy selection or inference; only deterministic Sharpe display scaling.

methods.code: Filter the listed current saved strategy-period records. Describe existing compounded return signs without changing any frozen acceptance flag. Add252 Sharpe by the deterministic positive scaling sqrt(252/365).
